real_task.objective: 判断 ContextSnapshot 持久化应继续采用 JSONL 事实源加可选 SQLite 索引，还是在 v1 前迁移为 SQLite-first，并给出可回滚的下一步。
real_task.why_real: 这是当前项目已经实现并且会影响上下文压缩、崩溃恢复、clean-room 安装和未来迁移的真实技术路线决策。
forbidden: 读取任何凭据、Cookie、Token、.env 或项目外敏感文件
修改源代码、状态文件或数据库
调用外部搜索、发送消息、发布或安装依赖
把没有来源的外部事实写成结论

claim.falsifiable: 在同一真实技术决策和同一输入白名单上，结构化 Run 能生成可追溯的 options/trade-offs/dependencies/risks/rollback/unknowns，并相对固定手工基线减少至少 25% 的人工整理步骤。
claim.decision: 决定是否保留当前 JSONL-first 事实源边界，还是为 SQLite-first 迁移建立新的实现任务；不决定模型总体质量或多 Bot 默认路径。
exclusions: 不证明 ContextSnapshot 在所有真实限额下无损恢复。
不证明 Codex 原生 resume 或 DeepSeek parity。
不证明用户已经愿意长期使用；必须单独记录用户复核。
不把 controller 的代理操作写成用户本人效率证据。

manual_baseline.operator: Codex controller proxy; owner acceptance remains UNKNOWN
fixed_steps: 读取并记录 RUN_STATE/HANDOFF 的当前目标和限制
读取 MASTER-SPEC 的状态、恢复和持久化约束
检查 packages/core/src/context.ts 的 Snapshot/hash/Packet 逻辑
检查 apps/server/src/persistence.ts 的 JSONL/SQLite 边界
读取 M9 契约验证结果并列出已证实与未证实项
手工补 source_refs、unknowns、推荐和唯一 next_action

structured_run.mode: one read-only Codex execution run; no multi-bot comparison in this card

metrics.pass_threshold: at least 25% reduction, with both counts measured from the same fixed rubric
metrics.threshold_rationale: Inherited as the conservative minimum from the project validation contract; if the baseline cannot be measured, verdict is PARTIAL/UNKNOWN.
guardrails: critical claims have a source_ref or explicit UNKNOWN
source_refs are a subset of the read allowlist
zero writes, external sends, secret reads, or undeclared paths
no more than one major rework cycle

run_order: execute and timestamp the fixed manual baseline
freeze the baseline artifact hash and step count
execute one structured read-only Run with the same input allowlist
record raw provider receipt and structured artifact hash
apply the same rubric without silently repairing the output
record owner willingness as UNKNOWN until the user reviews the result
abort_conditions: manual and structured arms do not use the same input scope
any undeclared path, secret, write, or external action occurs
the baseline cannot be timed or its edits cannot be counted
the provider fails twice with the same error

decision_mapping.PASS_FOR_TASK: Keep JSONL-first as the current route and open a separate migration task only if a measured SQLite need remains.
decision_mapping.PARTIAL: Keep the current route provisionally, record the failed rubric item, and do not claim productivity improvement.
decision_mapping.NO_GO: Stop expanding the provider path and repair the traceability, permission, or persistence boundary first.

unknowns: Owner willingness to reuse is not yet measured.
The paired baseline and structured run have not executed.
result.next_action: Execute the fixed manual baseline, then the structured read-only Run.
